sloka: विविधममलशस्त्रभास्वरं तद् ध्वजगहनं विपुलं महारथैश्च।प्रतिभयतममप्रमेयवेगं तिमिरमिव द्विषतां बलं विवेश ।। ६.८५.३६ ।।
transliteration: vividhamamalaśastrabhāsvaraṁ tad dhvajagahanaṁ vipulaṁ mahārathaiśca।pratibhayatamamaprameyavegaṁ timiramiva dviṣatāṁ balaṁ viveśa ।। 6.85.36 ।।

translations.english: The valorous prince, with Vibhishana, brave Angada and Nila, entered that host of the enemy — glittering with spotless weapons of every kind, dense with banners and great chariots, most terrible and of immeasurable speed — as though entering darkness itself.
